name: Shinkai Mitsuki
source:
"Eek...... An [b]extroverted[/b]  is coming this way......!"

An [b]introverted[/b] classmate who sits next to [url=/c138331]Yuzuru[/url] and often talks to him. She enjoys watching live streams and videos, due to her staying up late to watch them everyday, she has dark circles under her eyes. She has been recommending her favorite Performers to Yuzuru, but he never sees any of them.

*[b]This character has no route[/b].
